translations.web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
translations.bsb: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish; He will faithfully bring forth justice.
translations.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
translations.asv: A bruised reed will he not break, and a dimly burning wick will he not quench: he will bring forth justice in truth.
